name: contoso-book
title: Contoso Insurance — golden-record master dataset
description: The canonical, synthetic master data record set (the 'golden record') that validates the CRM Frontier Firm Showcase controls. Single source of truth is the typed fixtures under data/scenarios/advisor-cockpit/; this manifest declares the record set, load order, keys, relationships and publish targets. No real customer data (ADR-0026, copilot-instructions §3).

publishPaths.mechanism: Idempotent Web API upsert by alternate key via az rest (OIDC, no secrets).
publishPaths.use: CI + DEV pipeline seed (Phase 5.3). Re-runnable; converges to the golden state.
publishPaths.gated: DEV — target tables authored by Phases 1-3.

publishPaths.mechanism: Power Platform Configuration Migration data package (data.zip = data_schema.xml + data.xml + [Content_Types].xml), imported via Package Deployer / CMT / pac.
publishPaths.use: Portable, reviewable sample-data package promoted through DEV -> SIT with the solution, one artifact per environment ring.
publishPaths.gated: DEV/SIT — import validated once the DEV tables land.

loadOrder.reason: party root; everything references the household/business Account
interest on an existing person/account (ADR-0009); parents must exist
Databricks measure projection; scoped to GA/account (ADR-0026)

notes: Keys are alternate keys so both publish paths upsert idempotently (no duplicate golden records on re-run).
Non-analytics table/column logical names are provisional until Phases 1-3 land in DEV; the measure snapshot is contract-stable (Phase 4, ADR-0026).
This manifest is the machine-readable index; the executable CMT package builder is the first task in the implementation plan.
